# Load

```{R}
library(tidyverse)

tb_au <- read_rds("data/tb_tidy.rds")

tb_au %>% filter(country == "Australia")
```

# Heatmap

```{R}
library(visdat)

vis_dat(tb_au)
```

# Load

```{R}
library(naniar)

glimpse(oceanbuoys)
```

# Missingness mapping

```{R}
vis_miss(oceanbuoys, sort_miss = TRUE)
```

# Missingness summaries

```{R}
# Numerical summary measures of missing data 
s_miss <- miss_summary(oceanbuoys)
s_miss

# Proportion of missing data 
s_miss$miss_df_prop

# Proportion of variables missing 
s_miss$miss_var_prop

# Print data in variable miss_case_table
s_miss$miss_case_table

# Obtain missingness summary tables grouped by year 
s_miss_year <- oceanbuoys %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  miss_summary() %>% 
  ungroup()

s_miss_year$miss_case_table
```
